# Golden Path ranking reach: type-gate disposition + cold-start remedy

## Context

Consumer-5 leaf of epic neomjs/neo-agent-brain#122 (Golden Path v2) — "reach + read-ordering, not resurrection" — filed in the operator-directed full-fledging pass. Live latest-open sweep at 2026-07-02T19:37:34Z: no equivalent ticket.

The neomjs/neo#14454 same-run route-attribution ledger (merged `1666a3de4`, dataset in `learn/agentos/measurements/golden-path-route-attribution-2026-07-02.md`) resolved the acceptance fork **non-zero structural** in the hermetic scenario — the dead-write hypothesis was NOT confirmed. What remains live from the #14422 OQ4 decomposition: **structural cold-start** (new/unlinked nodes carry ≈0.00 structural weight, penalized precisely for being new) and the **type-gate/structural-mass disjointness** (durable structural weight concentrates on node types the ranking never reaches). Every production handoff now emits the ledger — the discriminating data accumulates automatically.

## The Problem

The Computed Golden Path ranks with structural weight it largely cannot reach: both independent probes in the graduation record observed the durable structural mass (35,443 `CONTAINS`, thousands of `IMPLEMENTS`/`RESOLVES`) living on file/concept/PR node types — disjoint from what the router admits. Meanwhile genuinely-new work is structurally invisible (cold-start), so the router systematically under-ranks exactly the items an operator most wants surfaced: fresh, unlinked, high-intent tickets. Result observed live: rendered `Structural: 0.00` intermittency and the original operator question — "why do new items that should reach golden path not yet?"

## The Architectural Reality

- **Type-gate (designed routing boundary):** `ai/services/graph/computedGoldenPathRouting.mjs:72-73` — only `ISSUE`/`DISCUSSION` route ("execution-steerable"); the 42.2% label/actionability exclusion on OPEN items is likewise DESIGNED (per the graduation's entry-gate decomposition). This leaf must not widen what ROUTES.
- **Candidate pool:** verify composition at claim time — the semantic candidate query on current dev constrains types at the Chroma `where` level (per the 2026-07-02 intake V-B-A), which may retire the older all-types crowding premise; the capture runs settle it with data.
- **Structural scoring:** `GoldenPathSynthesizer.mjs:749-750` (`getInboundStructuralComponents` → `struct_score`), post-selection reinforcement at `:872` (`GraphService.linkNodes('frontier', id, 'GUIDES', score)`).
- **Ledger instrument:** `ai/services/graph/goldenPathRouteLedger.mjs` — per-candidate rejection buckets + pre-ranking components + `GUIDES` writes in one pass.
- **Cold-start remedies matrix (from the graduation, explicitly "matrix material for the epic, not AC material"):** bootstrap weight · graduation-edge seeding · time-decayed novelty bonus · #14447 stall-rescue nudge (gated on its own OQ2).

## The Fix

Data-first, one PR:

1. **Capture-run analysis artifact** — aggregate ≥5 opt-in capture runs against the live store (diagnostics-runner pattern, the neomjs/neo#14513 sibling; the recording library revives from pre-#14518 git history — anchor: `goldenPathRouteLedger.mjs` @ `085dd2339^` lineage) covering: structural-score distribution over rendered items, cold-start incidence (age vs structural), pool composition (how much of top-20 the type-gate rejects), `GUIDES` reinforcement loop shape. Committed under `learn/agentos/measurements/`.
2. **One cold-start remedy implemented, chosen FROM that artifact** (not from preference): the matrix's four candidates each carry a falsifier — e.g. a time-decayed novelty bonus is rejected if the data shows cold-start items already reach render via semantic weight alone; graduation-edge seeding is rejected if graduated items show no systematic disadvantage.
3. **Structural REACH extension (visibility, not routing):** ranking may consume structural mass THROUGH concept-adjacent hops (e.g., an ISSUE inherits bounded weight from concepts it `IMPLEMENTS`/is `RESOLVES`-linked to) — while `computedGoldenPathRouting.mjs:72` continues to gate what ROUTES. The visibility-vs-routing boundary from the graduation stays intact and is asserted in the spec.
4. **Same-run proof:** the ledger (already emitting per handoff) shows the before/after — a cold-start fixture candidate carries non-zero structural via the remedy, and no non-`ISSUE`/`DISCUSSION` node renders as actionable.

## Decision Record impact

aligned-with ADR 0024 (consumes edge topology; no taxonomy/protection changes). The OQ1 anchoring leaf owns any ADR amendment.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Analysis artifact committed over ≥5 opt-in capture runs (live store, distinct days/store-states preferred) with the four-remedy matrix dispositioned (chosen one justified, three rejected with data cites)
- [ ] Chosen remedy implemented; hermetic same-run ledger spec proves a cold-start fixture reaches non-zero structural
- [ ] Concept-hop reach implemented with an explicit weight cap; spec asserts semantic ordering is never inverted by reach alone
- [ ] Spec asserts the routing boundary: no non-`ISSUE`/`DISCUSSION` node rendered actionable
- [ ] `Structural: 0.00` intermittency re-measured post-merge across ≥3 production handoffs (standing-watch note on this ticket)
- [ ] PR `Resolves` this leaf, `Refs` neomjs/neo-agent-brain#122

## Out of Scope

- Widening ROUTE admission (designed boundary).
- Label/actionability filter changes (designed, 42.2% exclusion documented as intentional).
- Anchoring writes (OQ1 leaf); retrieval consumption (consumer-1 leaf).

## Avoided Traps

- **Resurrection framing** — the goal is reaching weight that EXISTS and un-penalizing newness, not inflating scores until old items resurface.
- **Remedy-by-preference** — the matrix is dispositioned from ledger data; ambition does not pre-empt the probe (the epic's standing discipline).
- **Visibility/routing conflation** — concept mass informs ranking; it never makes a concept a routable work item.

## Sequencing

Executable now via opt-in capture runs (the passive per-handoff emission path was removed as handoff bloat per neomjs/neo#14517 — operator-directed; capture is on-demand by design). Independent of neomjs/neo#14474/the defrag leaf (consumes ids as-is; benefits from both).

## [SUPERSEDED — fold-in executed per Vega's blessed handover] Both residuals carried forward with receipts

Vega's bless (A2A 32b1863d, 2026-07-04 14:16Z) authorized folding this ticket into the live GP lane, preserving its two residuals. Disposition per residual:

1. **Structural cold-start remedy — SUBSUMED, merged.** PR neomjs/neo#14686 (merged 08:55Z, Resolves neomjs/neo#14659) ships exactly the reach-floor this ticket's residual named: `STRUCTURAL_COLD_START_EPSILON` + `inheritParentStructuralWeight` — a cold-start (~0) leaf inherits alpha × its parent-epic structural weight, fail-open, so tree-filed new nodes are visible to the normal formula instead of being penalized for being new. The candidate-starve half had already shipped (#13801 recency-sort + neomjs/neo#13837 pool); with neomjs/neo#14686 the structural piece is landed. Nothing of this residual remains unowned.

2. **Type-gate disposition — RE-SITED to neomjs/neo-agent-brain#115 as measure-then-dispose.** The 42.2% disposition-label filter question is NOT decidable without data — deciding it today would be a guess-number. neomjs/neo-agent-brain#115's guard-filter ledger (its item 2: blocked candidates recorded in the neomjs/neo#14454 route-attribution ledger with focus-reason attribution) is precisely the measurement that makes the disposition decidable. The residual is named on neomjs/neo-agent-brain#115 in a companion comment; the disposition decision fires when the ledger has a window of real data.

Vega's handover comment on this ticket remains the content-carry for the analysis lineage. Closing as superseded — not as done: the substance lives in neomjs/neo#14686 (merged) + neomjs/neo-agent-brain#115 (claimed, Ada).

* feat(graph): wire the route-attribution record-seam emit — fail-open, both guard branches (#15057)

AC2 of the record-seam. GoldenPathSynthesizer now records which computed candidates
the routing contradiction guard filtered (BOTH the partial-block and no-survivor
branches) into the route-attribution ledger, per synthesis run:

- buildRouteAttributionRecords (pure): blockedNodes -> records tagged with the
  focus-reason union across the armed Current Focus candidates + the per-node
  exclusion bucket.
- recordRouteAttribution (fail-open boundary): reads the retention/dir leaves at

  swallow-logged, never aborts synthesis.
- New AiConfig leaves in the memory-core goldenPath* set: LedgerDir/MaxEvents/
  PruneTriggerBytes; config.mjs re-materialized (overlay, gitignored).

3 mapping/fail-safe specs green; 59 existing synthesizer specs unbroken; 12 store
specs green. Makes the seam non-speculative; the disposition-feed follows a window.

* fix(graph): restore destructuring block-align --fix mangled into a syntax error (#15057)

check-block-alignment --fix corrupted
  const {blockedNodes = [], focusCandidates = []} = focusContradiction, focusReasons = ...
— it choked on the = defaults INSIDE the destructuring pattern, ate '[], focusCandidates = []} ='
and produced 'const {blockedNodes = focusContradiction, ...' (SyntaxError 387:139). It shipped
because --fix runs in lint-staged AFTER the local test pass, so the aligned version was never
run locally. Rewritten as block-align-stable plain consts (Array.isArray guards replace the
destructuring defaults). Verified: node --check + 15 specs pass on the post-hook file.

* fix(test): restore Synthesizer binding a replace_all clobbered from the main describe (#15057)

The AC2 commit removed 3 redundant per-test 'const Synthesizer = GoldenPathSynthesizer.constructor'
lines via replace_all — but that exact form also existed in the main describe's EXISTING tests, so
it deleted their bindings too. GoldenPathSynthesizer.spec.mjs:163 (the first user) threw
ReferenceError; mode:'serial' then SKIPPED the rest, surfacing in CI as a lone '1 failed' that masked
the cascade. Fixed by binding Synthesizer once in the main describe's beforeAll (mirrors the
hasCrossFamilyReview describe). Full spec: 50 passed / 0 failed / 0 skipped.

(incident/prio-zero), keeping the full diagnostic set separately as candidateReasons.

case: {incident, fresh-updated} -> armingReasons [incident], candidateReasons both. 15 passed.
